title: Replacement of Trestle tower at Bitra Lighthouse in the UT of Lakshadweep - Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized) at Deep Bhavan, Kochi.
summary: Fabrication and supply of a 30 m high hot-dip galvanized GI trestle tower at Deep Bhavan, Kochi, for replacing the trestle tower at Bitra Lighthouse, Lakshadweep.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kochi

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Kochi
sites.work: Location for fabrication and supply of 30m GI trestle tower

scope.item: Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized) for replacement of trestle tower at Bitra Lighthouse

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate to be sent by post/in person. Bid Securing Declaration also listed among documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies; OR for Lakshadweep contractors, island-works experience with any Government department during last 7 years
Satisfactory completion of similar works in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80%
Similar works: erection of trestle/lighthouse/communication tower or construction/maintenance of residential/institutional/office building, road etc. or related civil construction
CA-certified annual turnover of last three years
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking with list of relatives serving as gazetted/account officers in MoPSW/DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; tender acceptance letter; bid securing declaration
specs: 30 m high GI trestle tower, hot-dip galvanized
